answer: The cheapest real defence: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because jetty only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, sparrow is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any plume approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
